column1: # adapters/<id>/adapter.tsv — W4A-SPEC §2. One row per adapter, tab-separated, header first.
#   1  id                     ^[a-z]+$, matches the directory name and --platform spelling
#   2  display                human name in doctor output
#   3  detect_any             ':'-separated paths (~ ok) and bare binary names; ANY hit => DETECTED
#   4  skills_path_project    project-scope skill path pattern, relative to the repo (<name> slot)
#   5  skills_path_global     global-scope skill path pattern (<name> slot)
#   6  context_path           the context-injection file emit manages with a marker block ("-" = none)
#   7  docs_url               the platform doc page the shapes came from
#   8  docs_read              ISO date the URL was last verified (LIMITS #15 practice; an absent
#                             or empty cell is an unfilled PROBE-REQUIRED value => doctor DRIFT)
#                             yes|no|partial — the plan §3.3 capability matrix, as data.
# A malformed row (wrong column count, bad enum, id != directory, missing docs_read) is DRIFT
# by definition (R3): a capability table that cannot parse cannot be trusted.
